    Smoke-test all Skosmos instances in the bundled registry

    Source: R/instances.R
    skosmos_test_registry.Rd

    Runs skosmos_test_instance() sequentially over every endpoint returned by skosmos_instances(). Sequential execution is intentional because public terminology services may have usage policies that discourage parallel request bursts.

    Usage

    skosmos_test_registry(lang = "en")

    Arguments

    lang

    Preferred language used when requesting vocabularies.

    Value

    A tibble with one row per registered Skosmos deployment and columns for endpoint identity, response status, vocabulary count, message, and elapsed time.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
results <- skosmos_test_registry(lang = "en")
results

# Inspect only failures.
results[!results$ok, ]
} # }
